items.title: Emin's My Bed
items.claim: Tracey Emin's My Bed was shortlisted for the Turner Prize in 1999. In 2014 it sold at auction. For approximately how much?
items.reveal:
Christie's London sold My Bed for around £2.5 million (with buyer's premium) on 1 July 2014.

The work was later loaned to the Tate by Count Christian Duerckheim.
items.why: Markets give surprising answers to questions about value in conceptual and autobiographical art.

items.title: The painting most cited as Cubism's origin
items.claim: Which 1907 Picasso painting is most often cited as a key precursor to Cubism?
items.reveal:
Picasso painted the work in 1907 but did not exhibit it publicly until 1916. The fractured planes and reference to Iberian and African sculpture set the conditions for Cubism with Braque.

It is now in MoMA, New York.
items.why: A painting can remain influential through private circulation among artists before reaching the public.

items.title: Linear perspective demonstrated
items.claim: Filippo Brunelleschi is credited with demonstrating linear perspective. Around when did he stage his famous Baptistery experiment in Florence?
items.reveal_title: About 1420 in front of Florence's Baptistery
items.reveal:
Brunelleschi's experiment, recorded by his biographer Manetti, used a painted panel with a hole and a mirror to demonstrate single-vanishing-point perspective.

Leon Battista Alberti formalised the method in De pictura (1435).
items.why: A technical innovation can reshape an entire visual culture within a generation.
